# AstryxInputGroup { #anylumino.AstryxInputGroup }

```python
AstryxInputGroup(
    children=None,
    *,
    label,
    prefix='',
    suffix='',
    disabled=False,
    **props,
)
```

Group an input with prefix and suffix adornments.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Default    |
|----------|------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| children | ChildInput | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `None`     |
| label    | str        | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | _required_ |
| prefix   | str        | Text rendered before grouped input children.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `''`       |
| suffix   | str        | Text rendered after grouped input children.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `''`       |
| disabled | bool       | Whether the component should render disabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `False`    |
| **props  | Any        | JSON-safe InputGroup props. Useful keys: isLabelHidden, description, isOptional, isRequired, size, status, labelTooltip, data-testid, className, and style. anylumino manages label, disabled state, prefix, suffix, and child content. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/InputGroup>. | `{}`       |
